author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Tomb Raider: Definitive Survivor Trilogy Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer for this collection featuring three action games that dive into Lara Croft's full origin story. The Tomb Raider: Definitive Survivor Trilogy bundle includes Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition, Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration, and Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition, as well as the online modes and all DLC released for each title.

Follow Lara on her formative journey across the world, starting in Tomb Raider where she finds herself trapped on the shrouded island of Yamatai off the coast of Japan, to the harsh Siberian tundra hiding an immortal secret in Rise of the Tomb Raider, and finally to the mountainous landscape of Peru to uncover a cataclysmic power in Shadow of the Tomb Raider.

Tomb Raider: Definitive Survivor Trilogy is available now on Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Tomb Raider: Definitive Survivor Trilogy - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the console launch trailer for Peak, the co-op climbing game that is out now on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC. The trailer also showcases that a physical edition for PS5 will be available on December 9, 2026. The console version of Peak includes all content updates.

Peak is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
title: Peak - Official Console Launch Trailer

Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is available now on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. The Delta Chronicles 2 DLC will be available on October 28, 2026.
title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Official Delta Chronicles 2 DLC Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the announcement trailer for 10 Calls, an upcoming Halloween season dark comedy co-op game. 10 Calls will be available on PC in 2026.

In 10 Calls, death itself has shown up at the office. With a scythe. And a pumpkin on its noggin. Now it’s chasing your colleagues through meeting rooms, storage closets, and open-plan offices. To escape, all you have to do is answer a phone call. Preferably before you get sliced in half.

Find anything that might help you survive the shift, from a Bible to a gun. Fight back, hide, and don’t underestimate the garlic sauce. Got killed? Come back as a ghost: help the survivors, scare them, or play dirty tricks on them. Being dead is no excuse to leave the office party.

And if you’re playing as Death, you can finally do everything you’ve always wanted to do to this office! Summon hellhounds, reel in fleeing colleagues with your whip, and carve your way through the office furniture. Just watch out for colleagues with baseball bats and guns. For Deat
title: 10 Calls - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join narrative designers Seth Dickinson and Tim Partlett, along with creative director Anthony Gallegos, for a behind-the-scenes look at Subnautica 2. In this video, the developers discuss creating the narrative. They explore storytelling's role in shaping the underwater survival adventure game's latest content update, including a peek at what's coming for the Colonists' story, Axum's history, and letting players piece the story together through exploration, as well as how this update connects back to the Collector Leviathan. 

Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths. 

Subnautica 2 is out now in Early Access.

#Subnautica2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Subnautica 2 - Official Voyage to Early Access 2: Beyond the Surface

description:
Check out this clip from Dispatch featuring Erin Yvette (who plays Blonde Blazer), casting director Linda Lamontagne and creative director Nick Herman from developer AdHoc Studio as they discuss the casting of Invisigal. The clip showcases the new commentary mode available in the adventure game for its one-year anniversary with the free Deluxe Edition update. The update also includes a storyboard mode. Dispatch is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.

Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.
title: Dispatch - Exclusive Behind the Scenes Commentary Clip

description:

description:
Final Fantasy Resonance is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Steam. Watch the launch trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance, an RPG and the first Final Fantasy in HD-2D. A demo is out now featuring the opening through the end of Chapter 1, and you can continue your adventure by carrying over your demo saved data to the full game.

In Final Fantasy Resonance, return to the pixel‑art world of Final Fantasy, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions, echoes of beloved Final Fantasy characters, to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

#FinalFantasyResonance #Gaming #IGN
